crossRefs.note: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole…

translations.web: then the priest shall examine them. Behold, if the bright spots on the skin of their body are a dull white, it is a harmless rash. It has broken out in the skin. He is clean.
translations.bsb: the priest shall examine them, and if the spots are dull white, it is a harmless rash that has broken out on the skin; the person is clean.
translations.kjv: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.
translations.asv: then the priest shall look; and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be of a dull white, it is a tetter, it hath broken out in the skin; he is clean.
